title: [master]- Posting service order without External document no. will copy the 'Service Order No.' to GL entries
summary: When posting a service order without an external document number, the service order number is now correctly copied to GL entries instead of remaining blank.
key_points: Service orders without external document numbers now populate GL entry document references
Fixes inconsistent behavior where GL entries lacked document identification
Changes applied across multiple localization layers (W1, NA, ES, IT)
Test coverage added for the posting scenario
Ensures audit trail clarity in general ledger records
